newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Econ to buy stake in Indonesia miner.
newsitem.headline: Econ to buy stake in Indonesia miner.

text.p: Investment holding company Econ International Ltd said on Wednesday it had conditional agreement to buy a 49 percent stake in an Indonesian coal-mining company.
Econ said in a statement it would buy 1.47 million new ordinary shares of 1,000 rupiahs each in the capital of PT Multi Tambangjaya Utama (MTU).
It said it would finance internally the subscription payment of about Singapore $900,000.
The statement also said MTU intended to acquire 40 percent of another Indonesian coal-mining company, PT Sinar Benua Prima for S$171,000.
Econ said the agreement was conditional upon MTU being granted foreign capital investment status by Indonesia.
